About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. Stripe’s Professional Services Sales team works with our most strategic users. You will help customers accelerate their growth and adoption on Stripe. This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations during pre-sales that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises, ultimately driving revenue growth through our professional services offerings.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Services Manager, you will sell Professional Services engagements to strategic clients and drive Stripe’s future growth engine by building relationships with prospective users and turning them into happy Stripe users.

Responsibilities

  • Own the entire Professional Services sales cycle for enterprise companies.
  • Partner with Account Executives on named account lists to develop account plans aimed at winning and expanding Professional Services business with enterprise clients.
  • Drive the success of Professional Services by managing and forecasting bookings.
  • Craft custom proposals that align with clients' business outcomes, utilizing services across Professional Services and partner offerings.
  • Advise senior leadership in customer organizations on building business cases for digital transformation.
  • Lead pre-sales workshops with customers, focusing on strategy, vision, discovery, and assessment.
  • Shape Professional Services deals, and build and negotiate contracts/Statements of Work.
  • Engage with Product and Engineering teams to influence product strategy for large clients.
  • Collaborate effectively with GTM partners to integrate complementary strategies and drive mutual growth objectives.
  • Prepare the delivery team with user insights to ensure that the delivery aligns with the desired business outcomes.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of professional services sales experience, preferably at a technology company or a consulting firm, with a track record of top performance.
  • Proven experience in pre-sales and sales of sizable service engagements, as well as in contract and Statement of Work (SOW) development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large transformational engagements using disruptive technologies.
  • Thrives on the urgency and importance of working with our largest customers, achieving set objectives while balancing competing priorities.
  • Ability to understand complex business requirements and develop tailored solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity to produce strategic insights and identify opportunities.

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge of the sales cycles associated with a SaaS product or technology platform for strategic enterprise customers.
  • An in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and the ability to lead complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner.
  • Experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies.
  • A proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment among a broad set of stakeholders, including engineering, sales, support, product, marketing, data science, and senior leadership, to achieve growth targets.
  • Experience in building and scaling a go-to-market (GTM) growth discipline, including the development of strategy, processes, and operating models.
  • Proven ability to create a strong growth culture within a team.
  • Background in a growth-stage internet/software company and/or the payments industry.
  • Familiarity with APIs and their role in digital solutions.

  • Prepare and submit Luxembourg Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Cellule de renseignement financier (CRF) for Bridge Building S.A., working closely with the MLRO and in line with established governance

  • Identify potential control gaps through casework analysis and recommend solutions to mitigate financial crime risks across the programme and in individual cases
  • Serve as a point of contact for investigation-related inquiries from law enforcement and FIUs, financial partners, auditors, and other external stakeholders
  • Demonstrate sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex, high-risk cases where the correct decision may not be immediately clear

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in investigative roles within financial crime, AML, risk, intelligence research, or a related field
  • Fluency in English and French
  • Demonstrated experience preparing regulatory disclosures, including direct experience with Luxembourg STR filings and goAML
  • A deep understanding of financial technologies, including payments, cryptocurrency, stablecoins, and Banking-as-a-Service products
  • Strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU AML, terrorist financing, and sanctions regulations
  • Stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with MLROs and communicate complex risk decisions clearly
  • Excellent research and writing skills and the ability to produce concise, decision-ready investigative outputs
  • The ability to synthesise large amounts of information, including transaction data, using tools such as SQL, Excel, and AI
  • The ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment
  • The ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion

Preferred qualifications

  • ACAMS or a similar professional certification
  • Familiarity with macOS and Google products
  • Technical curiosity and an interest in evolving financial crime compliance trends

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

The Role

We are hiring a software engineer on the Developer Experience team. You will own projects from the first problem statement through production, and measure whether they worked.

The team owns how developers discover, adopt, and operate Alchemy: the dashboard, APIs, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server that sit between our infrastructure and the people building on it. A growing share of those users are coding agents, so we design for both.

Recent work spans enterprise controls, management APIs, developer observability, onboarding, and self-serve growth. Ahead of us is the shift to agents that discover tools, write code, pay for services with x402, and operate onchain infrastructure on their own.

Our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Kafka, AWS, and Kubernetes.

  • Agent-native developer tools: our CLI, SDKs, MCP server, x402 payments, and Agent Wallets.

  • Enterprise capabilities for teams running production traffic: organizations, roles, SSO, key management, audit history, and spend controls.

  • Public and management APIs for usage, billing, apps, and teams, used by developers, internal tools, and coding agents.

  • Developer observability and product quality: usage analytics, request logs, alerts, and the reliability of the surfaces developers use every day.

What You Will Do

  • Own projects from problem definition through design, launch, measurement, and on-call.

  • Design APIs with clear versioning, error handling, safe defaults, and backwards compatibility.

  • Build data models and services that stay correct and reliable as traffic and customer needs grow, with security built in for users, agents, and services.

  • Build the user-facing side of your features across our dashboard, CLI, and SDKs, so developers and coding agents can discover and use them safely.

  • Instrument what you ship. Use activation, adoption, and conversion data, plus direct developer feedback, to decide what to build next.

  • Write design docs, runbooks, and developer-facing documentation. Review code and technical designs to keep quality high.

  • Work with Product, Billing, Security, Growth, and other engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

At six months, you have:

  • Execution: Scoped, designed and shipped a project across our APIs, backend services, and dashboard or CLI, and paying customers use it in production.

  • Ownership: Joined on-call and handled incidents in your area without escalating. Your launches ship with alerts, a runbook and a rollback plan.

  • Impact: Moved a number you can name, such as feature adoption, free-to-paid upgrades, time to first API call, or support tickets.

  • Team: Earned the team’s trust by making sound technical decisions, collaborating across functions, and improving code and design quality.

  • Direction: Proposed what the team should build next, backed by usage data and conversations with developers.

Helpful Experience

  • Blockchain experience is helpful, not required.

  • Developer platforms, API products, cloud consoles, or enterprise developer tools, including SDKs, CLIs, MCP servers, agent tools, or machine-readable documentation.

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

Polymarket is making a high-stakes bet on crypto markets right now, and this role owns the full product surface for crypto within the US app — 15-minute markets, hourly markets, weekly markets, strike markets, up/down markets across assets. You'll be setting the roadmap, coordinating execution, and making the calls that determine whether we win or lose market share against our competitors.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. The mandate is clear: grow Polymarket's share of crypto markets, starting with the US app. Crypto markets are technically complex — with real market structure considerations, liquidity dynamics, and resolution mechanisms that matter — but the audience we're building for is retail. Pay Transparency
